general.nativeTitlebarDesc: Use your system's default window titlebar instead of Pairview's custom one.

locations.title: Library Locations
locations.intro: Folders Pairview browses: your internal disk, external drives or a NAS share. Nothing is copied, and removing a location never touches its files.
locations.empty: No locations yet. Add the folder where your photos live, for example your NAS's DCIM folder.

status.differentVolume: A different disk is at this path

locations.noSuggestions: Pairview couldn't find this folder on any connected disk.
locations.checkAddress: same share name, different server address: check it's the right one
locations.excludesDesc: Comma-separated folder names, or paths inside this location. NAS system folders (@eaDir, #recycle) are always skipped.
locations.pollDesc: How often Pairview looks for new or changed files, for example camera uploads to the NAS. Local disks also update instantly.
locations.removeDesc: Pairview forgets this location and its cached thumbnails and data. Your photos and sidecar files stay where they are.
